integrity: The Lyapunov derivative is checked by exact polynomial expansion in the bundled dependency-free verifier.
The infinite-time conclusion is proved analytically; numerical trajectories are not used as certification.
The earliest public source date and primary MSC are taken from the publisher record.
limitations: The proof is restricted to the equal-feedback slice \(k_0=m=s>0\).
The critical boundary \(h^2=ab\) is not classified.
The condition \(h^2\ge ab\) is proved only as a necessary condition for non-equilibrium compact recurrence, not as a sufficient one.
title: Global stability on the equal-feedback slice of the four-dimensional Rabinovich system
